measurement_note: Size is the numeric value n. Each tier is one less than a power of two, so the O(log n) greedy reference finishes in two operations. A correct graph-search alternative computes shortest distances for every integer up to the next power of two and therefore performs Theta(n log n) transition work before returning the requested distance.
